purpose: Source-grounded adapter contract for the original cached Codely Quick Generate and History client. Not a replacement UI, a server schema, or proof of official service access.

source.sourceLayer: anonymous remote client referenced by original packaged GUI; captured 2026-10-02, not embedded in cowork.exe

transport.httpResponseEnvelope: Axios response interceptor returns response.data; endpoint bodies below are the direct values consumed by components. Do not add a generic status/content or task wrapper.
transport.errorConsumption: Response interceptor rejects Error(JSON.stringify(response.data || fallback)); generation awe reads error/message/msg/target from that JSON.
transport.localPolicy: Local compatibility routes must not copy original account cookies or token values. Keep the original request/payload/response shapes while binding only owned local storage and explicitly configured Providers.

identityAndQuota.reason: HNe calls za.isLoggedIn() and returns studio-login-page when no user exists. UIe in embed mode loads only when vs.authStatus === authed; its pending state suppresses loading.
identityAndQuota.userMeShape: Direct user object, not {data:user}; za.fetchUser directly reads n.id and sets user=n. Anonymous HTTP failure sets fetchStatus=failure. A successful null value is invalid for this consumer.

localIdentityRecommendation.requiredChanges: Use an explicit local identity/capability state in the small host/auth compatibility seam; do not manufacture a codely:auth token or claim official SSO login. Keep original HNe/UIe component trees.

unknownQuotaRecommendation.reason: Official balances, paid status and price quotes are unavailable. Null is unknown; 0 would claim a measured zero/free price.

originalConsumption.credits: Only typeof currentCredits === number updates balance. Only typeof credits === number accepts a quote.
originalConsumption.subscription: paidType string is interpreted by C1e; internal or paid and internal email affect capabilities. Missing paidType marks paid-status request unavailable.
originalConsumption.embedBootstrap: s1e requires a real token and GET /editor/sso/bootstrap; local mode needs an explicit separate path, not a fake successful official bootstrap.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Direct user object only when representing the actual local/official identity in its corresponding mode; otherwise explicit unavailable/auth failure.
Local adapter must not fabricate successful official SSO bootstrap.
routes.localAction: explicitly unsupported in local mode; bootstrap local identity in its separate seam

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Optional direct or data-wrapped {currentCredits:number}; keep unknown as null/unavailable.
routes.localAction: unavailable, never invent a balance

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Optional direct or data-wrapped {paidType:string,productCode:string}.
routes.localAction: unavailable, never manufacture paid/internal

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Optional direct or data-wrapped {credits:number}.
routes.localAction: unavailable without actual price source

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Optional direct or data-wrapped {credits:number,fingerprint:string}.
routes.localAction: unavailable without actual quote service

request.fileField: image/video/audio/model/splat matching the operation; model-conversion uses model

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Direct or data-wrapped {url:string}; downloadUrl and imageUrl are accepted aliases. The original uploader stores the returned URL, not a native inputId.
routes.localAction: Register real owned bytes; return an absolute loopback resource URL with actual extension. Unsupported source media must return a real failure, not an invented URL.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Immediate actual output recognized by wN, or taskId/task_id/id/data.taskId/data.id for polling.
routes.localAction: Map the original model ID only to an explicit configured local backend; preserve original data and resolve owned reference URLs. Return an honest not-configured error otherwise.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Direct task or data-wrapped task with status, error/errorCode and output.data actual media fields. hwe reads status at top/data; wN/k5 extract actual output.
routes.localAction: Query the same owned task; no second generation on poll. Map local interrupted to a terminal failed response with its real reason, rather than an unknown status that the client would poll forever.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: {tasks:TaskRow[],total:number,page:number,size:number}; UI directly reads tasks/total and actual list length.
routes.localAction: Adapt owned task history without changing the original history layout, category/date/tag filters or pagination.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Direct TaskRow; /task status wrapper tIe adds id and createdTime from createTime*1000 if absent.
routes.localAction: Owned task detail only; deny unavailable global/email scopes rather than return someone else or a synthetic empty detail.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: {globalHistoryView:boolean}; true enables all/email history ownership controls.
routes.localAction: Return globalHistoryView:false for local single-user scope; do not invent organization access.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: {workspaces:string[],page:number,hasMore:boolean}; original infinite list flattens string names.
routes.localAction: List actual own workspace names present in owned history; never query original Hub/account history.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: {records:UploadRecord[]}; original caller requests page=1,pageSize=500 and constructs the input material view itself.
routes.localAction: Return actual registered local input URLs, kind and createdTime.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: {tags:Tag[]}; each tag requires id/name, with optional aliases/description/scope/count.
routes.localAction: Use a real own tag store; an initially empty tags array is honest only when that own store is empty.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Direct created Tag object; FL passes it to onSaved, which reads tag.id.
routes.localAction: Persist local definition before successful response; if unimplemented return failure rather than synthetic tag.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Direct updated Tag object.
routes.localAction: Persist real local metadata.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Response value ignored on success; real failure must reject. Deletion removes tag metadata, not files or task rows.
routes.localAction: Remove actual local definition and associations only.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: {results:[{taskId:string,updated:boolean,error?:string}]}; zZ accepts only each row with updated=true and no error. {updated:N} alone is NOT sufficient.
routes.localAction: Return exact per-task mutation outcomes after persistence.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: {updated:number}; absent updated falls back to submitted batch count in Tz, so local adapter must report true counts/errors.
routes.localAction: Change discarded metadata only; never equate with remote cancellation or file deletion.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Flat prefs object, e.g. generationViewMode:grid|list; NOT {prefs:{...}} on read.
routes.localAction: Read own persisted user UI preference.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Return shape not consumed by caller; persistence must actually succeed.
routes.localAction: Merge own preferences without changing unrelated values.

routes.responseConsumedByOriginalClient: Direct or data-wrapped {url:string}.
routes.localAction: Accept only an owned resource identity/URL and return its actual local download endpoint. No arbitrary remote download proxy.

observedFields.type: original task type or explicitly marked local model ID
observedFields.name: actual task/model title

input.data: exact original builder payload; preserve all model-specific fields and owned URL references

output.data: actual output tree; Eo/TN traverse this field for history previews/downloads

taskRow.absoluteMediaUrlRequired: History TN, iL/MN, Pwe and Iwe mostly require absolute http(s) URLs. Preserve real extensions in owned loopback paths. Relative /api/editor paths work only in the narrow download-key branch; relative /api/tauri paths will not populate ordinary original thumbnails/assets.
taskRow.regeneration: jwe merges input.param then input.data. studioKind/studioModelId, when genuinely recorded at generation, identifies the exact original descriptor; otherwise jwe maps actual task type. wF restores original fields conditional on selected descriptor support. Do not truncate history to prompt/model alone.

observedFields.url: absolute http(s) actual owned file URL
observedFields.kind: image|video|audio|model|file|splat; splat maps to model in view

uploadRecord.clientConstruction: U5 merges output and input URLs from tasks with Iwe(upload records), creates roles/input/output and deduplicates. There is no independent required /assets history API in the observed view.

tag.scopeUserMeans: locally editable private tag in this original UI
tag.doNotInvent: AI tags or counts without actual data; the UI filters an empty name and the built-in name 游戏资产.

historyConstants.dateBoundaries: Dp(start) uses Asia/Shanghai-like +08:00 midnight string; end boundary is next day +08:00 midnight. Preserve exclusive end semantics.

states.completeRule: completed OR actual recognized preview/output while not in a pending state

generationLifecycle.cancelBoundary: Observed discardTask stops local timers/card and changes discarded metadata; no original remote cancel endpoint is established.

generatedVariants.source: OK = kK.map(...) inherits frontier-game-design descriptor iw and wraps its build. Do not evaluate here or pretend these are among the 45 literal definitions.

registry.preserve: Keep original xN descriptors, model.build functions, helper dependencies and VNe controls in the original client. The fixture is evidence, not a substitute model UI or executable dynamic schema.
registry.payloadToModeWarning: descriptor.kind is not the four-way UI mode: use proven xN grouping; prompt, skybox, layering, effect and model are auxiliary kinds.

remainingUnknowns: Official service implementation and actual upstream Provider secrets are not present.
Official account entitlements, credits and prices are not present.
Audio, FBX/ZIP/EXR/HDR/GIF/splat inputs or outputs exceeding own backend capability must fail explicitly; do not claim the original broad formats already work.
Mapping a visible original descriptor to an owned configurable Provider must be explicit. Never silently send an original model request to an arbitrary configured provider.
Core cannot infer original builder payload or exact model from prompt alone; preserve them at the compatibility boundary.
